_note: Single source of age-appropriate chores. Used by generate.js (PDFs), and copied into the age pages and the chart maker. 'top' fills the pre-filled PDF and the chart maker's suggestions; 'rows' is how many chore rows the weekly chart has for this age (fewer, bigger boxes for little ones). No knives, stove, cleaning chemicals or power tools below the teen chart.

Bedroom: Put toys in the toy bin
Put dirty clothes in the hamper
Pull the blanket up on the bed
Put books back on the shelf
Kitchen: Put napkins on the table
Carry their own plastic cup to the counter
Wipe up small spills with a damp cloth
Pets: Help scoop food into the pet's bowl
Help give the pet fresh water
Outdoors: Pick up toys in the yard
Water plants with a small watering can
Helping others: Help put away unbreakable groceries
Match socks from the clean laundry
Bring a diaper or wipes to a grown-up
Throw their own trash in the bin

Bedroom: Make the bed (a simple version counts)
Put dirty clothes in the hamper
Kitchen: Set the table with napkins, cups and spoons
Clear their own plate
Wipe the table with a damp cloth
Put away plastic dishes
Pets: Gently brush a calm pet with help
Outdoors: Pick up sticks in the yard
Help carry in light shopping bags
Helping others: Sort laundry into lights and darks
Match socks
Help unload unbreakable groceries
Dust low shelves with a dry cloth

Kitchen: Set and clear the table
Load plates and cups into the dishwasher
Wipe the counters with a damp cloth
Put away spoons and forks
Make a simple no-cook snack
Pets: Feed the pet and refresh the water
Walk the dog with a grown-up
Helping others: Fold towels
Sweep with a small broom
Dust with a dry cloth
Empty the small trash cans
Help a younger sibling tidy up

Bedroom: Make the bed and tidy the room
Change the bed sheets with help
Kitchen: Load or unload the dishwasher (a grown-up handles sharp knives)
Pack their own school lunch
Wipe the counters and table
Help with dinner prep, like washing vegetables or measuring
Pets: Feed the pets and refresh the water
Outdoors: Take out the trash and recycling
Bring the bins back from the curb
Helping others: Vacuum a room
Fold and put away family laundry
Sweep or dust the living room
Help a younger sibling with a chore

ages.label: Teens

Bedroom: Wash and dry their own laundry
Kitchen: Cook a simple meal once a week
Clean up the kitchen after dinner
Help write the grocery list
Empty the dishwasher
Pets: Look after a pet's daily needs
Clean a cage, tank or litter box
Outdoors: Mow the lawn, once a grown-up has shown them how to do it safely
Sweep the porch or shovel snow
Take the bins to the curb
Helping others: Clean a bathroom
Vacuum and mop shared rooms
Help a younger sibling with homework or a chore
Run a simple errand for the family

top: Cook a meal once a week
